text: After this you can apply a historical teaching factor without treating it as a current standard.

One older Canadian teaching exercise applies a factor of 1.98 to purchased electricity; an appendix in the same workbook reports a Canadian grid value of 1.96. It also includes historic ratios of 1.01 for natural gas and 1.0 for certain on-site generation. These numbers belong to their stated examples or historical reference context. Source EUI adds an upstream-energy perspective; none of these older ratios is confirmed for a current project.

items: Inferred: Illustrative calculation: With a historical factor of 1.98, 100 GJ of purchased electricity becomes 198 GJ on that exercise’s source-energy basis, not necessarily any present-day basis.
